# Repository metadata

The GitHub settings for `coderscantina/v1per`. GitHub keeps them outside the repo, so this file is the source to apply them from.

## Description

Self-hosted uptime monitoring and status pages for agencies and MSPs. One instance for every client, with a node tree, invites, incidents, remote probes and Uptime Kuma import. One Rust binary, one Docker image.

## Topics

`uptime-monitoring`, `status-page`, `self-hosted`, `monitoring`, `incident-management`, `uptime-kuma`, `rust`, `msp`, `agency`

## Apply

```bash
gh repo edit coderscantina/v1per \
  --description "Self-hosted uptime monitoring and status pages for agencies and MSPs. One instance for every client, with a node tree, invites, incidents, remote probes and Uptime Kuma import. One Rust binary, one Docker image." \
  --add-topic uptime-monitoring,status-page,self-hosted,monitoring,incident-management,uptime-kuma,rust,msp,agency \
  --enable-discussions
```

## Social preview

GitHub has no API for it. Upload `.github/social-preview.png` under Settings, General, Social preview. Regenerate it from `scripts/social-preview.html`.
